FX-DIFFUSE-001.says: The settings as they start, radius 10, amount 50, screen: every pixel that shows is lightened, never darkened, by half its screen with the glow; every pixel of the dark shadow and the line lifts more than any of the pale skin or the light, whose red, already full, stays at 1; the coverings are kept, and the empty pixels, the hole in the skin among them, stay empty.

FX-DIFFUSE-002.says: Amount 100: the whole screen laid on, every pixel lifted further than in FX-DIFFUSE-001, which is exactly halfway between the drawing and this.

FX-DIFFUSE-005.says: Radius 3, sigma 1: a tight glow. The shadow just left of the light, at (2, 4), lifts more than at radius 10, and the shadow in the far corner, at (1, 1), less than a fifth as much.

FX-DIFFUSE-006.says: Radius 20, sigma 6.67: a glow as wide as the cel, nearly the same colour everywhere, so the most-lifted shadow pixel lifts less than 1.3 times the least (at radius 10, more than twice).

FX-DIFFUSE-007.says: Blend lighten, amount 100: each channel takes the larger of its own and the glow's, so the shadow and the line lift, and the light, brighter in every channel than the glow round it, stays exactly as it is.

FX-DIFFUSE-008.says: Blend normal, amount 100: every pixel that shows takes the glow's own colour at its own covering, the picture blurred. The soft edge, where the blur covers less than 0.4 as nothing lies to its right, takes the colour of what is near it, divided by that covering and so not darkened by the emptiness, and the hole stays empty.

FX-DIFFUSE-009.says: Blend normal, amount 50: halfway between the drawing and FX-DIFFUSE-008, so the light darkens as the shadow lightens.

FX-DIFFUSE-010.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-DIFFUSE-001 and frame 4 is FX-DIFFUSE-006.

FX-DIFFUSE-011.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 0 is the drawing, and at frame 2 it has gone past 100 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-DIFFUSE-002.

FX-DIFFUSE-012.says: FX-DIFFUSE-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved, the glow worked on the drawing before it is placed.

FX-DIFFUSE-013.says: Radius 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-014.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-015.says: Amount 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-016.says: Amount -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-017.says: Blend "add", which is not screen, lighten or normal. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DIFFUSE-018.says: Radius keyed to 600 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
